title: feat(workflow): bind executions to reasoned order revisions
body:
Reasoned analysis revisions now reconcile the actual WorkItems, supersede all prior ACTIVE revisions in one transaction and retain their historical lines. New first, repeat and scientific executions bind a usable order line before INSERT. Existing attempts, lines, OPEN first-fill identities and recorded scientific history remain unchanged.

Both routes and initial intake use one order service under Claudio's [revision scope](https://github.com/yigini/soilfer-lims/issues/209#issuecomment-6163271808). A changed command supplies a reason and complete normalized target. Multiple retained ACTIVE revisions are accepted for deliberate reconciliation; the installer does not clean them up, normalize rows or add a unique index over duplicates. New ACTIVE uniqueness is enforced by source-bound triggers. New order lines have a nullable immutable `workItemId`, validated at insertion as a scalar historical identifier. There is no WorkItem foreign key, because the released workflow can remove unstarted work while retaining its line identifier. New execution resolves a linked line first, otherwise exactly one legacy NULL-linked match within exactly one ACTIVE revision. Missing/ambiguous/multiple contexts return `409 ORDER_LINE_REQUIRED` without writes; retained historical OPEN first fill keeps its original identity.

The [fraction direction](https://github.com/yigini/soilfer-lims/issues/209#issuecomment-6166518424) preserves every existing non-WAIVED SAND/SILT/CLAY owner, including completed work, with fixed companion lines alongside logical TEXTURE in the same reasoned transaction. Partial one/two-owner triples refuse `409 TEXTURE_FRACTION_OWNERS_INCOMPLETE` with missing codes and zero writes. No fraction owner, alias mapping, requiredAnalyses expansion, report or derivation change is introduced. Explicit removal of TEXTURE uses ordinary reasoned reconciliation.

Both keyed modes follow the [receipt contract](https://github.com/yigini/soilfer-lims/issues/209#issuecomment-6169628053): one scoped receipt in the same transaction; identical replay returns the exact original public response without writes; differing reason/payload or cross-mode reuse returns 409 without writes; no key creates no receipt. Mode participates in the normalized payload hash; the internal hash is excluded from replay responses without rewriting retained receipts.

**Runtime-reachable group, kept as refusal/impact evidence:** the released48d intake caught initial-order failures after creating WorkItems, so missing revisions or matching lines can persist. Current intake creates the initial revision and lines in the same transaction; injected initial revision and line INSERT failures now prove rollback of all new WorkItems/order rows/lines/audits. Under the [approved-orphan direction](https://github.com/yigini/soilfer-lims/issues/209#issuecomment-6167740581), #209 keeps the approved-edit409 and scientific preflight before PROCESSING. It adds no amendment-side order step, backfill, relink or wider fallback. Read-only kit reporting distinguishes no ACTIVE revision, ACTIVE with no matching line, ambiguous line, multiple ACTIVE revisions, incomplete fraction owners and continuing/ambiguous OPEN reservations. It separately lists prospective new scientific-attempt refusals on noneditable measurement owners. Approved-amendment impact must be explicitly zero before proceeding; nonzero means STOP, show YY the sample list and a separately reviewed forward remedy. Nonzero ordinary open-work lists also require YY's sample list before a fresh gate. These collectors use explicit read-only connections and injected resolution, and have only been tested against owned data; no production count collection occurred.

**Fixture-only group, individually classified before corrections:** the original full run's650 failed assertion occurrences were matched individually to current/released creation paths. New positive numerical/reference fixtures declare exact legacy NULL order contexts on their existing analytical owners; negative missing-order/draft/scoped/operational/spectral/invalid-closure cases keep their intended refusals. Mandatory reason inputs were supplied at positive revision and injected rollback sites while deliberate missing-reason tests remain unchanged. A direct single-entry mock already had a usable ACTIVE order; an actual diagnostic found absent mock `req.headers` before the order service, while mounted Express supplies that object. Only its mock header context changed. Its original afterAll then hit the retained order-line FK: the two original teardown delete calls now run only when no retained attempt exists, preserving immutable parents and runtime FK guards. The PRE201 fixture explicitly declares only the digest-bound209 schema primitive it lacks; redundant schema additions to current spectral/publication fixtures were removed after their honest duplicate-column failures. Every other retained assertion and original literal fixture statement is recovered by removing the recorded additions. Scientific values, unit factors, raw aliases, methods, ownership, old attempt/line identities and strict scanner predicates remain intact.

**Changed legacy expectations:** exactly one: keyed analyses receipt count0→1, explicitly accepted in6169628053 because callers' keys must not be silently ignored. Eight meaningful added cases cover both modes' exact original response replay/all-table zero writes, different-reason409, cross-mode409 and no-key/no-receipt behavior. Four additional cases cover native initial revision/line rollback, read-only orphan cause breakdown and approved-orphan nonzeroSTOP/noneditable refusal. All other legacy assertions remain unchanged.

The source-bound additive installer and default entrypoint retain DRY 0/APPLY 1/NO_OP 0, original DB/WAL/SHM preservation, missing/partial/tampered refusal, startup before jobs/listen and the policy/control-chart/container predecessor chain. No production installer attempt or operation has occurred for this PR.

The read-only impact report now matches scientific amendment eligibility: only ACCEPTED, non-duplicate measurement owners on noneditable samples can raise the prospective amendment STOP. WAIVED work and marked duplicates cannot trigger that list. Malformed stored fraction analysis lists are reported as INVALID_STORED_ANALYSES with sample/owner IDs without throwing, blocking schema-ready startup, repairing data or normalizing stored values. Unexpected schema/SQL errors still refuse. Seven new checks cover waived/duplicate exclusion and ACCEPTED orphan STOP, plus six malformed JSON/list shapes with original file/row equality and startup readiness. Fresh retained spellings in the new exclusion fixture normalize to the same analysis while honoring its raw unique key. All old integration source and assertions are byte-exact recoverable; no runtime, scientific, DDL or scanner change.

Validation on exact source-only head `6bd516c42a07332d0b0653ed150d1526bf7e424e`, tree `638580d50f61254609de3abd42d93afc676a5727`, base `2242bcb4861a7085bb95e78e0e7b1e4edf11d1b8`:

- Current ordinary focused verification: **5/5 suites and333/333 tests passed**, both scanners, startup readiness and full order integration included; all370 discovery paths and1327 frozen source/shared/generated-Prisma/scenario/template inputs unchanged. Both stock setups and worker512MB/blank NODE_OPTIONS retained. This is focused proof, not a full result for the new head.
- Prior full local and ONE stock CI38615738432 passed370/5642/all370inventory/all real Docker steps on predecessor562cab2d24b25a500041a44abf384ffc4dbfad7c. Its actual audit6176831479 failed on the two report points corrected here; every original result remains immutable. The new automatic CI must complete370 suites/expected5649 tests and all real Docker steps before a new exact-head audit PASS or merge.
- Delta from the audited predecessor is exactly three paths: installer impact reporting, seven added integration cases, and documentation. All122 application paths equal the retained tested source; WP and audit attributes are excluded. All650 original failure occurrences/59 passing report references and original1653-line fixture provenance remain retained. Existing client evidence is unchanged.

[Current closed focused originals](https://github.com/yigini/soilfer-lims/tree/762472b4c8bba4394a23960faff8a940b20267fa/WP/backlog-resume-20261013/issue209-pr297-impact-audit-correction-focused-spelling); [actual predecessor findings](https://github.com/yigini/soilfer-lims/pull/297#issuecomment-6176831479). Initial focused setup refusal and subsequent332PASS/one new fixture raw-unique-key failure remain honestly retained; neither was replayed. The existing retention guard and schema were unchanged.
